snippet.title: Breathedge 2 - Official Early Access Release Window Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Take a look at the Early Access Release Window Trailer for Breathedge 2, a space first-person action-adventure survival RPG developed by RedRuins Softworks. Players will embark on a reckless mission to find themselves in outer space, filled with numerous dangers and things to explore. Build, craft, manage your crew, look after the chicken, and defeat the evil space corporation in this new, breathtaking survival game. Breathedge 2 is launching into Early Access in August 2026 for PC (Steam).
